GameMode.Title: 🎮 GAME MODE
GameMode.Description: GPU/CPU priority, stop background services and free memory for maximum FPS
GameMode.HowItWorks: Game Mode stops non-critical background services (Windows Search, SysMain/Superfetch, telemetry, updaters), raises the active process priority to 100% (Realtime class) and switches the system to the Ultimate Performance power plan (or High Performance) for minimal stutters and maximum FPS.
GameMode.StandbyDesc: Calls the native system API NtSetSystemInformation (SystemMemoryListInformation → MemoryPurgeStandbyList), which flushes modified and standby memory pages. This eliminates micro-stutters and frees RAM without a reboot.
GameMode.PurgeFail: Standby RAM purge failed (administrator rights required).

Msi.Title: ⚡ MSI MODE FOR PCI DEVICES
Msi.Description: Message Signaled Interrupts for GPU, NVMe and network adapters
Msi.TooltipWhat: MSI Mode is a modern interrupt mechanism where the device sends message interrupts over the PCIe bus instead of a shared IRQ line. It reduces latency and CPU load during gaming.
Msi.TooltipPriority: High priority means device interrupts are handled with the highest priority in the DPC queue, providing minimal I/O latency and smooth FPS.
Msi.TooltipLimit: Interrupt limit (MessageNumberLimit) is the number of interrupt vectors the device can use to parallelize IRQ processing across CPU cores.
